needed.evidence: Footway width under 1m and partly blocked by parked cars or other obstructions, creating a hazardous informal path
needed.suggestion: Widen the left footway to at least 1m and clear obstructions to create a safe and usable pedestrian path.

needed.evidence: Right footway under 1m and obstructed by parked cars or other items
needed.suggestion: Clear the obstructions and maintain the footway on the right side to ensure unobstructed pedestrian movement.

needed.evidence: Uneven sections or obstructions on the left footway
needed.suggestion: Repair and smooth out the left footway to eliminate trip hazards and improve pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: Uneven or broken sections in the right footway
needed.suggestion: Repair and maintain the right footway to remove trip hazards and provide a safe pedestrian path.

needed.evidence: Pedestrian crossing with signals but obstructed and potentially not adequate for safe crossing
needed.suggestion: Upgrade the crossing by installing a refuge island in the middle of the wide road to split the crossing and slow traffic, enhancing safety for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Lack of dropped kerbs at the crossing
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at the pedestrian crossing to ensure accessibility for all pedestrians, including those with disabilities.

needed.evidence: Wide road with four or more lanes without a refuge island
needed.suggestion: Install a refuge island in the middle of the crossing to provide a safe waiting space for pedestrians while crossing the busy road.
